data.name: Ashleigh
data.gender_notes: Ashleigh is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Maiden living in an ash grove
data.long_meaning: The name Ashleigh is derived from the Old English words æsc meaning ash tree and leah meaning clearing or woodland glade. This name was used to describe a young woman living in a grove of ash trees. It is also believed to have been derived from the Old English word æsceleigh, meaning ash meadow. The name Ashleigh carries the meaning “Maiden living in an ash grove” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ashleigh usually hope their child will grow to embody maiden living in an ash grove and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the strength and resilience of the ash tree, and the peaceful, calming energy of the woodland.

in_hebrew.name: אשלי
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים הוא מקלטי, אלוהים הוא ישועתי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אשלי נגזר משורשים עבריים שפירושם 'אלוהים הוא מקלטי' או 'אלוהים הוא ישועתי'. השם מורכב משני חלקים: 'אש' שפירושו 'אלוהים' ו-'לי' שפירושו 'מקלט' או 'ישועה'. השם אשלי משקף את הקשר בין האדם לאלוהים, כאלוהים שהוא המקלט והישועה של הנפש.

in_greek.name: Ασκλη
in_greek.meaning: Θεός είναι η σωτηρία μου, Θεός είναι η προστασία μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ασκλη προέρχεται από εβραϊκές ρίζες που σημαίνουν 'Θεός είναι η σωτηρία μου' ή 'Θεός είναι η προστασία μου'. Το όνομα αποτελείται από δύο μέρη: 'Ασ' που σημαίνει 'Θεός' και '-κλη' που σημαίνει 'σωτηρία' ή 'προστασία'. Το όνομα Ασκλη αντανακλά τη σχέση μεταξύ του ανθρώπου και του Θεού, ως Θεός που είναι η σωτηρία και η προστασία της ψυχής.

in_latin.name: Ashleigh
in_latin.meaning: Deus est mea salus, Deus est mea protectio
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Ashleigh derivatur ex radicibus hebraicis quae significant 'Deus est mea salus' vel 'Deus est mea protectio'. Nomen constat ex duabus partibus: 'Ash' quod significat 'Deus' et '-leigh' quod significat 'salus' vel 'protectio'. Nomen Ashleigh reflectit relationem inter hominem et Deum, ut Deus qui est salus et protectio animae.

in_english.name: Ashleigh
in_english.meaning: God is my salvation, God is my refuge
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ashleigh originates from Hebrew roots, meaning 'God is my salvation' or 'God is my refuge'. It is derived from two parts: 'Ash' meaning 'God' and '-leigh' meaning 'salvation' or 'refuge'. In Christian tradition, the name Ashleigh symbolizes the individual's relationship with God, emphasizing God's role as savior and protector. Historically, the name has been used across various Christian cultures, signifying spiritual meaning, personality traits associated with faith and trust, and modern usage as a given name for children.

data.cultural_impact: Ashleigh was quite a popular name in the English-speaking world during the Middle Ages. It was a name given to girls born near ash groves or ash trees, and was believed to symbolize strength, resilience, and a deep connection to nature.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ashleigh can also be seen as a reminder of the spiritual and symbolic importance of trees in various religious and cultural traditions. Ash trees, in particular, have been revered for their longevity, strength, and ability to withstand storms and pests. In Christianity, the ash tree is sometimes associated with the resurrection of Christ, as the tree's annual budding is a testament to new life and rebirth. The name Ashleigh can thus be seen as a reminder of the eternal and enduring nature of faith, hope, and love. Additionally, the name can be interpreted as a call to live deeply in nature, and to find peace, refreshment, and inspiration in the beauty and goodness of the natural world.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ashleigh: Derived from Old English, meaning 'dream or ash tree meadow.' Symbolically, it represents the tranquil beauty of nature, as well as the power of dreams and intuition. Spiritually, it signifies the ability to find peace and wisdom in the quietest corners of life.
